description_en: Queries the integration configurations for audit logs of third-party cloud assets
description_zh: 查询第三方云资产审计日志接入配置
name: DescribeCloudVendorTrialConfig

parameters.help_en:
The unique ID of the AccessKey.

You can call [DescribeCloudVendorAccountAKList](~~DescribeCloudVendorAccountAKList~~) to obtain the AuthId.
-
parameters.name: auth_id

parameters.help_en:
The cloud asset vendor. Valid values:
Tencent: Tencent Cloud
AWS: Amazon Web Services
parameters.help_zh:
云资产厂商。取值：
Tencent：腾讯云
AWS：亚马逊
parameters.name: vendor

AuthInfo.description_en:
The multi-cloud configuration information:
AWS: The response parameters sqsQueueName and sqsRegion.
Tencent: The response parameters kafkaUserName, kafkaBootstrapServers, and kafkaTopic
AuthInfo.description_zh:
多云配置信息：
AWS：出参 sqsQueueName、sqsRegion
Tencent：出参 kafkaUserName、kafkaBootstrapServers、kafkaTopic

Message.description_en: The error message returned when an integration error occurs
Message.description_zh: 接入错误时返回的错误提示消息

Status.description_en:
The accessed state of the trail configuration. Valid values:
init: initialization
verify: authenticate the configuration
enable: configuration effective
disable: configuration invalid
error: integration fault
timeout: integration timeout
Status.description_zh:
Trail配置的接入状态。取值：
init：初始化接入
verify：配置验证中
enable：配置生效
disable：配置失效
error：配置接入错误
timeout：配置接入超时

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
